notes.title: Spring update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43194530/6476e11541206a202b672a8b7f9fd2b4ee63a991.gif[/img][h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] The points allocation system has been revised.
[*] Backgrounds in the main menu, level selection menu, and gameplay have been updated.
[*] The level selection menu has been updated.
[*] Notification for consecutive matches has been added.
[*] A level completion counter has been added, specifically a three-star rating.
[*] A timer and move count tracker have been added.
[*] Three independent leaderboards have been added. The old leaderboard is no longer in use but will not be deleted. トニートニー・チョッ - the best, such as Shaelima[fr] and May Special :)
[*] The Spanish translation has been corrected. Thanks, G. S.!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43194530/8d5535213f2fe587f59dd185dbcb6366f7dee7a1.gif[/img]
[h3]Kids Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*] The option to show flipped tiles in Kids Mode has been added. Thanks, Querio!
[*] The rotation speed of the tiles in Kids Mode has been slightly reduced to allow for better viewing.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43194530/d4383bb19bd4ed5a4739f33145828cdf401aaff1.gif[/img]
[h3]Time Trial Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*] Time Trial mode has been added.
[*] Sounds for the timer running out have been added.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43194530/a92fcfc590935a6abde96362e24c4196e051e6ed.gif[/img]
[h3]Sound[/h3]
[list]
[*] Finally fixed the issue where background music could stop. We hope it's fixed... Thanks, Raziel!
[/list]

notes.title: Winter update!
notes.content:
[h1]List of changes[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43194530/cc5776693d7e6ce8b93ad819aef69481662da34b.gif[/img]

[h3]Updates:
[/h3][list]
[*] New stamps added
[*] Added level selection option
[*] Added toddler mode (thanks to Querio)
[*] Removed timer countdown, but still counts for points
[*] Added windowed mode (thanks to Randy Marsh)
[*] Added new achievements (thanks to harlequen2)
[*] Added leaderboard
[*] Added languages like Italian, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, Romanian, Japanese, and Hindi.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43194530/41c6923fb49fa2496eb072bb4da85d4d7b3f07a5.gif[/img]

[h3]Work on mistakes:[/h3]
[list][*] Code optimized.
[*] Fixed minor bugs like sound disappearing in main menu (thanks to Raziel)
[/list]
